status.summary: Ranked #5 at middleweight on the media rankings (#6 on the Meta list); pro record 18-2 (1 NC). He lost to Nassourdine Imavov (UD, UFC Paris, Sep 6, 2025), then beat Reinier de Ridder 30-27 on all cards at UFC 326 (Mar 7, 2026) despite fracturing a rib in training about two weeks before. The rib did not heal and was displaced, so he had surgery in June 2026 and pulled out of an unannounced UFC 330 bout with Joe Pyfer (Aug 15, 2026). He is booked against Yousri Belgaroui (11-3) in a three-round middleweight bout at UFC 334, Madison Square Garden, New York, on Nov 14, 2026.

style.summary: A powerful, explosive southpaw who now leads with striking (86.5% of decayed sig landed comes at distance): hard one-twos, big hooks and kicks to all levels, with opportunistic wrestling, heavy ground-and-pound and quick back takes in reserve. He is very hard to hurt and builds momentum slowly, so he tends to win late rounds and sometimes gives away early ones.

moves.notes: Target groups follow fighters.json decayed sums: sig attempts 70.8% head, 17.6% body, 11.6% leg (career 71.4/17.5/11.0). The middleweight league split is about 77/14/9, so he works the body and legs more than average. Within the head group (revised Nov 6, 2026): Sherdog's UFC Paris preview (Ben Duffy, Sep 4, 2025) describes 'hard one-twos, huge hooks and a variety of hard kicks to all levels', so the rear-hand straight leads (0.30), hooks are raised to 0.25, the jab follows at 0.22 and the head kick gets 0.12; overhand and uppercut stay small. Body kicks lead the body group (open-side kick of a southpaw, plus 'kicks to all levels'); ufcstats does not separate punches from kicks. Leg kicks are split evenly. Knee and elbow are minimal because his clinch share is under 4% of sig landed; ground strikes come after takedowns and are carried by the engine's grappling knobs. No spinning attacks are recorded. Medium-low confidence: one technique source.

engine_notes.note: Five-round output rises steeply across his two five-rounders: R3 is 2.57x R1 and R5 is 3.52x R1 (Cannonier, by round: 15, 21, 37, 30, 50; Imavov: 6, 7, 17, 12, 24). Small sample of two fights.

He has shifted from grappling to striking: decayed ground share of sig landed is 9.9% against 13.9% career, and takedowns per 15 minutes are 0.75 decayed against 1.08 career.
